title: discovery_area
description: A place the Discovery station may search: a state, or a named region inside one state, kept as data so states are switched on and off and regions are edited in the Console (see DISCOVERY_GUIDE.md and DISCOVERY_AREA_GUIDE.md). A state's ZIP codes come from the shared ZIP table, so a state record holds no ZIP list. A region holds its own ZIP list. Rules the schema cannot express: one live state record per state_code; a region name is unique within its state; every ZIP in a region must belong to the region's state (a service checks the ZIP table); an inactive state or region cannot be run; a region inside an inactive state cannot be run; a ZIP may belong to more than one region; fields marked readOnly are set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept until the owner deletes it. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

kind.description: state (a whole US state, with the ZIP codes from the shared table) or region (a named group of ZIP codes inside one state, such as a metro area). Required.

name.description: The plain-words name shown on the map and in lists, such as Colorado or Denver metro. Up to 120 characters. Required.

state_code.description: The two-letter state code, capital letters, such as CO. For a region, the state it lies in. Required.

zip_codes.description: The five-digit ZIP codes in this region, up to 3,000, no repeats. Required for a region; not allowed on a state.

is_active.description: Whether a run may search here. A state starts false except the ones Todd switches on. Required.

notes.description: Anything worth remembering, free text up to 2000 characters. Optional.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
